close_reason: not a bug: onSuccessUpdateOriginal is not in RFC 8620/8621; keys are correct per Email/set semantics
description: RFC 8620 §6.3 says onSuccessUpdateOriginal is a map keyed on the *copy_id* (creation id string from the 'create' map). The handler in email.rs:1357 correctly iterates copied_source_ids and looks up patches by copy_id. That part is correct. However, the implicit Email/set response (email.rs:1407) places the results keyed by source_id (the original email's id from fromAccountId). RFC 8620 §6.3 says the implicit Email/set response should be keyed with the *copy_id* values from the original request. A client correlating which copy-id led to which result cannot do so correctly if the response is keyed by source_id. Trigger: Email/copy with onSuccessUpdateOriginal:{'c1': {...patch...}} where the source email id is 'abc' — the implicit Email/set 'updated' map will have key 'abc' instead of 'c1', breaking client correlation.
title: Email/copy onSuccessUpdateOriginal key semantics differ from RFC
